newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks drift negatively, depressed by raid.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks drift negatively, depressed by raid.

text.p: Tokyo stocks continued to drift negatively in the Wednesday afternoon session, depressed by worries that more major brokerages could be involved in the Nomura Securities Co Ltd payoff scandal, brokers said.
They said market participants were waiting for industrial output data due to be released at 0430 GMT and trade was subdued.
As of 0418 GMT, the Nikkei average was down 65.51 points, or 0.32 percent, at 20,337.23.
Its September futures had shed 50 points to 20,350.
